subject: Interview for Senior Backend Engineer — day-of conflict / proposal to reassign panel & reschedule
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Vaughn <evaughn+apply@gmail.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: CoriTech Recruiting <ops@coritech.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Interview for Senior Backend Engineer — schedule + prep

Hi all,

Quick note: confirming the onsite loop for Ethan tomorrow (Mon 8/23) at 10:00am PT — schedule + calendar invite attached (interview-invite.ics). Panel: Grace (system design), Neha (data systems), Dylan (code + backend).

Ethan — thanks again for taking the loop. Attachments in this thread: Ethan's resume (resume-evaughn.pdf) and the interview agenda in the calendar invite. Plan is 60 min total (10 + 20 + 30) with 10 minutes at the end for debrief.

Please reply if anything changes. If the candidate needs to shift, we can either:
- compress the session to 45m (shorter code exercise)
- swap in an alternate interviewer for a single slot
- reschedule to the next morning (8/24)

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: resume-evaughn.pdf, interview-invite.ics

From: Ethan Vaughn <evaughn+apply@gmail.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 07:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview for Senior Backend Engineer — schedule + prep

Hi Jasmine — really sorry to do this last-minute. My son's school unexpectedly closed this morning due to a water main break and I need to be home with him for the next few hours. I can try to take a shortened phone-first session in an hour if the team can do that, otherwise I need to ask to move the interview.

If it's possible, I can do:
- 11:30am PT today (shorter session) OR
- any time tomorrow morning (8/24) before 11am PT.

I know this is late notice — apologies. I can make myself available if there's any flexibility.

Best,
Ethan
Ethan Vaughn
+1 (650) 555-4499

Thanks for the heads up. I can cover the systems/data slot if we compress the loop today — I can do a focused 20 minute systems deep-dive instead of the usual 30. Dylan, I know you're scheduled for code — if you can keep the code portion to 20 and we do a 10 minute wrap, we could finish ~11:00.

If anyone prefers reschedule, I have 8/24 free 8:30–10:30. Either option works for me.

Also: if we compress today, let's use a short take-home as a follow-up instead of an in-session whiteboard so it's fair to the candidate. I'll note that in the interview feedback form.

Neha

Cc: CoriTech Recruiting <ops@coritech.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview for Senior Backend Engineer — schedule + prep

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick responses. Two practical options:

1) Compress loop today (start 11:30am PT):
   - Grace: 11:30–11:50 design (20m)
   - Dylan: 11:50–12:10 code (20m)
   - Neha: 12:10–12:30 systems deep-dive (20m)
   - 12:30–12:40 quick debrief (10m)
   - Jasmine: I'll own follow-up take-home if needed (short coding task sent via email).

2) Reschedule to tomorrow 8/24 9:00am PT (full 60m loop) — preserves full coding exercise and reduces pressure on the candidate.

Ethan — which do you prefer? If you pick option 1, we'll switch to phone/video (no shared IDE) and keep it tightly timed. If option 2, we'll send a new calendar invite for 8/24 9:00am PT.

Also tagging CoriTech to note candidate availability and let them update their scheduling record.

Thanks,
Jasmine

Attachments: interview-invite.ics

From: Ethan Vaughn <evaughn+apply@gmail.com>

Subject: Re: Interview for Senior Backend Engineer — schedule + prep

Jasmine / team — thanks so much for being flexible. I think option 2 is better — I'd prefer the full loop if possible so I can do the coding exercise properly rather than a rushed phone exercise. Please send the updated invite for Monday 8/24 9:00am PT.

Appreciate it, and sorry again for the disruption.

Best,
Ethan
